text:
Here my life is;

this sand so clear, with designs

of wanderings dedicated to the wind.


Here my voice is;

this empty shell,

shadow of sound

that suffers its own lament.

Here is my pain. This broken coral,

surviving its poetic moment.

Here is my inheritance

—this solitary sea that on one side was love,

and on the other was forgetting.

translation.title: Here My Life Is...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the shore objects as life, voice, pain, inheritance, love, and oblivion.
